newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine 42-day T-bill rises to 17.679 pct.
newsitem.headline: Philippine 42-day T-bill rises to 17.679 pct.

text.p: The average yield on the Philippine 42-day treasury bill rose to 17.679 percent from 15.770 percent last week, the Bureau of Treasury said on Tuesday.
Yield on the 35-day bill rose to 17.527 percent from last week's 15.617, it said.
Of bids worth 3.955 billion pesos tendered for the 35-day bills, the Treasury accepted 1.5 billion.
The 42-day bills fetched tenders totalling 3.194 billion pesos of which the Treasury accepted 500 million.
